+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT = ROOT / "out"
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+
+con = duckdb.connect()
+annual = con.execute(
+    """
+    SELECT
+        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date)::INTEGER AS year,
+        SUM(number_of_pedestrians_injured)::BIGINT AS pedestrians_injured,
+        SUM(number_of_pedestrians_killed)::BIGINT AS pedestrians_killed
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+      AND borough = 'BROOKLYN'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """,
+    [str(ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet")],
+).df()
+annual["year"] = annual["year"].astype(int)
+annual["pedestrians_injured"] = annual["pedestrians_injured"].astype(int)
+annual["pedestrians_killed"] = annual["pedestrians_killed"].astype(int)
+annual["pedestrian_casualties"] = (
+    annual["pedestrians_injured"] + annual["pedestrians_killed"]
+)
+assert annual["year"].tolist() == list(range(2013, 2026))
+
+coverage = con.execute(
+    """
+    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
+           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE borough IS NULL) AS null_borough_rows
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    """,
+    [str(ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet")],
+).fetchone()
+total_rows, null_borough_rows = coverage
+null_share = null_borough_rows / total_rows
+
+
+def draw_line(values, column, title, subtitle, y_label, filename, color, note):
+    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5, 5.8))
+    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.11, right=0.96, top=0.82, bottom=0.18)
+    ax.plot(
+        values["year"], values[column], color=color, linewidth=3,
+        marker="o", markersize=6, markeredgecolor="white", markeredgewidth=1.2,
+    )
+    ax.scatter(values["year"].iloc[[0, -1]], values[column].iloc[[0, -1]],
+               color=color, s=65, zorder=4)
+    ax.annotate(f"{values[column].iloc[0]:,}",
+                (values["year"].iloc[0], values[column].iloc[0]),
+                xytext=(0, 12), textcoords="offset points", ha="center",
+                fontsize=10, fontweight="bold", color=color)
+    ax.annotate(f"{values[column].iloc[-1]:,}",
+                (values["year"].iloc[-1], values[column].iloc[-1]),
+                xytext=(0, 12), textcoords="offset points", ha="center",
+                fontsize=10, fontweight="bold", color=color)
+    ax.set_title(title, loc="left", fontsize=19, fontweight="bold", pad=18)
+    ax.text(0, 1.025, subtitle, transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=11, color="#444444")
+    ax.set_ylabel(y_label, fontsize=11)
+    ax.set_xlabel("Crash year", fontsize=11, labelpad=10)
+    ax.set_xticks(values["year"])
+    ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelrotation=0, labelsize=9)
+    ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=10)
+    ax.set_xlim(2012.5, 2025.5)
+    ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
+    ax.grid(axis="y", color="#d9d9d9", linewidth=0.8)
+    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+    for spine in ("top", "right", "left"):
+        ax.spines[spine].set_visible(False)
+    ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#aaaaaa")
+    ax.text(0, -0.21, note, transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=8.5, color="#555555")
+    fig.savefig(OUT / filename, dpi=180, facecolor="white")
+    plt.close(fig)
+
+
+casualties = annual[["year", "pedestrians_injured", "pedestrians_killed", "pedestrian_casualties"]]
+casualties.to_csv(OUT / "values_1.csv", index=False)
+draw_line(
+    casualties, "pedestrian_casualties",
+    "Fewer Brooklyn pedestrians were hurt or killed in 2025 than in 2013",
+    "Annual pedestrian injuries plus deaths in police-reported Brooklyn crashes",
+    "Pedestrian casualties", "option_1.png", "#176B87",
+    "Full calendar years only (2013–2025). Borough-missing crashes cannot be assigned to Brooklyn. Source: NYC motor vehicle crash records.",
+)
+
+fatalities = annual[["year", "pedestrians_killed"]].rename(
+    columns={"pedestrians_killed": "pedestrian_deaths"}
+)
+fatalities.to_csv(OUT / "values_2.csv", index=False)
+draw_line(
+    fatalities, "pedestrian_deaths",
+    "Brooklyn pedestrian deaths were higher in 2025 than in 2013",
+    "Pedestrians killed in police-reported Brooklyn crashes each year",
+    "Pedestrians killed", "option_2.png", "#B34136",
+    "Full calendar years only (2013–2025). Borough-missing crashes cannot be assigned to Brooklyn. Source: NYC motor vehicle crash records.",
+)
+
+print(annual.to_string(index=False))
+print(f"coverage rows={total_rows}; null borough={null_borough_rows}; share={null_share:.6%}")
+print(f"casualties 2013={int(annual.iloc[0]['pedestrian_casualties'])}; 2025={int(annual.iloc[-1]['pedestrian_casualties'])}; change={(annual.iloc[-1]['pedestrian_casualties'] / annual.iloc[0]['pedestrian_casualties'] - 1):.6%}")
+print(f"deaths 2013={int(annual.iloc[0]['pedestrians_killed'])}; 2025={int(annual.iloc[-1]['pedestrians_killed'])}; change={(annual.iloc[-1]['pedestrians_killed'] / annual.iloc[0]['pedestrians_killed'] - 1):.6%}")
